From: Tom Li <tom.li@skycap.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner readiness: MAP weekly checkpoint and SDK auth blockers

Hi Camila,

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's MAP checkpoint: the engineering team at Skycap hit a blocker with our OAuth2 flow (token exchange failing intermittently) and streaming stalls when we pass tool-call payloads larger than 3KB. Both are blocking our end-to-end evals. Can we confirm owners and target dates for fixes this week? Also can you attach the latest MAP with the evaluation plan so we can align QA runs?

Suggested attendees: Camila, Karthik, Monica, and our infra lead Sanjay Mehta.

Thanks,
Tom
Senior Platform Engineer
Skycap AI

Attachment: error-log.txt (text)

Subject: Re: Partner readiness: MAP weekly checkpoint and SDK auth blockers

Tom — thanks for the heads up. I've attached the current MAP and the eval plan (see attachments).

Proposed plan for the checkpoint call (30 min):
- Quick run through outstanding MAP milestones (5 min)
- Engineering updates on OAuth2 token exchange (Karthik) + ETA (8 min)
- Streaming/tool-calling repro and mitigation plan (Monica) (8 min)
- Agree on gating for E2E eval and next sync (9 min)

Action items (assigned):
- Karthik: investigate intermittent token-exchange failure, prioritize root cause, target fix + test by 2027-04-12 EOD. (attachment: MAP_Roadmap_v3.xlsx -> row 12)
- Monica: reproduce streaming stall with tool-call payloads and propose fallback (chunking or smaller payloads) by 2027-04-13 mid-day.
- Camila (me): update MAP with owners, schedule a short follow-up if either item slips past target dates; prepare QA run template for Skycap using eval_plan_v1.pdf.

Meeting: 2027-04-10 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET — I sent a calendar invite to the group. Please add any infra folks on your side (Sanjay).

Attachments: MAP_Roadmap_v3.xlsx, eval_plan_v1.pdf

--

On Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 6:05 PM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Tom — thanks for the heads up. I've attached the current MAP and the eval plan (see attachments).
>
> Action items (assigned):
> - Karthik: investigate intermittent token-exchange failure, prioritize root cause, target fix + test by 2027-04-12 EOD.

Quick status update before the call:
- Root cause hypothesis: token-exchange failure appears correlated to token refresh races when multiple parallel requests hit the same refresh token window; suspect a cache invalidation edge-case in our auth proxy.
- Repro: I can reproduce locally with a stress script that issues parallel refreshes at ~150 rps. Logs attached to my internal note (not sent to Skycap).
- Short-term mitigation: add a mutex around refresh calls in the proxy (will push a patch to staging today). This should reduce failures significantly while we produce a proper fix.
- ETA: staging patch by 2027-04-10 5:00 PM PT; smoke tests and canary to Skycap staging by 2027-04-11 morning; target full fix + regression tests by 2027-04-12 EOD.

I'll report back in the meeting with a short demo of the smoke test results and the log before/after.

-Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Li <tom.li@skycap.ai>

Subject: Re: Partner readiness: MAP weekly checkpoint and SDK auth blockers

Thanks everyone — the plan and owners look good. We'll be ready to run the E2E eval once Karthik's staging canary is green and Monica's fallback approach is documented. I'll bring Sanjay to the call in case we need infra-level coordination.

Short checklist from our side before the call:
- Provision test client keys for staging (Sanjay)
- Confirm payloads that reproduce the streaming stall (I will attach a minimal repro before the call)

See you 10 AM PT.

Tom
